definitions.explanation: The very best or most excellent, especially as awarded in competitions and evaluations. Almost always used attributively with の or in compound award names like {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう} (grand prize).

examples.japanese: {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
{彼|かれ}は{最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{選手|せんしゅ}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: He was chosen as the most valuable player.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{映画祭|えいがさい}で{最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{作品|さくひん}{賞|しょう}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: That film won the award for best picture at the film festival.

notes:
Composed of {最|さい} (most) + {優秀|ゆうしゅう} (excellent, superior). Used attributively, typically in award and ranking names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう}: grand prize; best award
- {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{選手|せんしゅ}: most valuable player (MVP)
- {最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}{作品|さくひん}{賞|しょう}: best picture / best work award

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}: excellent — the base adjective without the superlative {最|さい}
- {最高|さいこう}: best; highest — broader and more colloquial; can describe feelings and experiences, not just formal rankings
